title: Thomas Russo VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
Brands, Luxury, and the Power of Patience 
Weetabix as the gateway to brand investing, Nestlé's loss of self-criticism, and a case-by-case view of luxury.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The interview argues that investors should distinguish between companies with idiosyncratic problems that are correcting versus those with steady, indispensable franchises. It suggests that Diageo and Apple are at or near a bottom due to specific consumer or market dynamics, while Cartier represents a stable luxury play. Conversely, Nestle is viewed with caution due to past cultural issues, even as it attempts to redirect its efforts.
